message.content: Microsoft Corporation trades at a close of 493.95 within an uptrend supported by a 20-day average of 494.46 and a 50-day average of 450.95, while the 200-day average sits at 429.54. The company maintains an operating margin of 45.1 per cent compared to 44.9 per cent a year earlier after beating estimates for eight consecutive quarters with zero misses. Recent earnings reactions show mixed price moves including a 15.51 per cent increase following the latest report on 2026-07-30 and a 12.59 per cent surprise, alongside a 4.40 per cent surprise after the session on 2026-04-30. The stock faces immediate resistance at 506.35 and support between 491.30 and 500.60 as it navigates these technical levels.
